_comment: Per-field value guide (generated by scripts/build_value_guide.py from schema.json). Tells a filler what each field should contain, with formats, address components, calculations to validate, and adversarial values to avoid. Not legal advice.

county.label: County
county.expects: a Maine county name WITHOUT the word 'County' (the form prints 'COUNTY'); rendered upper-case

docket_no.label: Docket No.
avoid: a docket from another jurisdiction's format

minor_name.label: Minor Name
minor_name.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

filing_date.label: Dated
avoid: a value that runs across a printed comma or '20__' stub — those are separate day/month/year fields

by_signer_name.label: By (signer for institution)
by_signer_name.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

by_signer_title.label: Its (title of signer)
by_signer_title.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

conservator_address.label: Address of Conservator for Court records
conservator_address.expects: free text answering the printed prompt

conservator_phone.label: Telephone Number
conservator_phone.expects: free text answering the printed prompt
